attributes.probed_form: No source edit was probed. The MECHANISM was proved by A/B-ing the sweep's own filter in lane scratch (CX_scratch/cx_sweep_twosided.py, not promoted -- tools/gdl is claude-fleet-worker-T21's claimed scope this run): cancel_prefixes() reconciles a residual key only against the OTHER SIDE'S RESIDUAL, so a prefix partner that BOTH sides read sits in neither residual and cancels nothing. Reconciling each residual key against the other side's FULL key set instead measured 'ONE-SIDED (shipped) findings: 12 / TWO-SIDED (proposed) findings: 6 / ADDED by the two-sided filter: (none)'. The six dropped rows are ALL of the sweep's real-0 rows plus three more of the same shape: SuicideExplosion (real 0), pbTraverseDrawObjects (0), pbTreeTraverse (0), sounds::AudioBuildMusicName (31, our '@313' is one 8-byte 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF entry against retail's two 4-byte lbl_80348450/lbl_80348454), sfx::StartMagicFX (50) and sfx::StartExplosion (191), the last two the same lbl_80348068 zero as row 3. The six SURVIVORS -- critter::CritterAnimInterrupt 132, boss::ProcessSpewItems 173, player::setup_player_display 183, player::create_player_blits 278, player::damage_player 301, combat::get_cam_wpos 438 -- are the negative side of the calibration and are untouched by the change.
attributes.residual: ROW 1+2, pb_tree (REFUTED). The flagged datum is the STORE DESTINATION `alpha_tree_dist`, not a constant either function reads. The aligned view is identical on both sides at the site: '40: stfs f0,0(0) @alpha_tree_dist(EMB_SDA21)' with f0 loaded two instructions earlier from '38: lfs f0,0(0) @lbl_80348FE8' (target) / '@@2' (ours), BOTH 0xBF800000 (f32 -1.0). config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt line 7966 declares 'alpha_tree_dist = .sdata:0x80343FA8; // type:object size:0x8 align:4 data:float' -- an 8-byte claim over a 4-byte float plus 4 zero bytes of end-of-section slack, which datadiff prices as the .sdata 0x20-vs-0x1C debt. So the target key is B:BF80000000000000 and ours is B:BF800000 for the SAME storage; the sweep renders the 8-byte form as 'f64 -0.0078125', a value nothing in the image ever loads. ROW 3, sfx::SuicideExplosion (REFUTED, and its real 0 is itself an artifact). At +0xdc and +0x230 the target loads 'lfs f0,0(0) @lbl_80348068' while ours loads '@@13'; poolval.py 0x80348068 prints 'lbl_80348068 @0x80348068 .sdata2 size 0x5 / bytes 00 00 00 00 00 / f32 0.0', so BOTH sides load f32 0.0 and the only difference is that our object materialises a fresh anonymous 4-byte zero where retail reuses the 5-byte shared zero (src/game/sfx/sfx.c already spells that idiom `extern f32 lbl_80348068;` at 4 other sites). SuicideExplosion is ALSO webfrank-pinned (config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json game/sfx/sfx::SuicideExplosion, REGISTER_ONLY, 107-insn sibling block), so its 'real 0' is post-rule: the SAME sweep with --raw ranks it 'real 98'. The sweep's own --raw flag exists for this and neither the T20 report nor the work order used it.

hypothesis.statement: HANDOFF TO claude-fleet-worker-T21 (tools/gdl owner). Make cv_scalar_datum_sweep.cancel_prefixes two-sided: drop a target-only key when ANY of OUR keys is prefix-equal to it, and an ours-only key when ANY TARGET key is prefix-equal to it, comparing against the full key sets rather than the residuals. Second, independent fix: the sweep keys STORE-destination relocations (stw/stfs into .sdata/.sbss globals) as if they were constants the function reads -- claim.law.CS_wrong-constant-detection... already excluded that class from cs_constsweep.py by measurement and this sweep re-admitted it; both pb_tree rows die on either fix alone, which is why the two must be evaluated separately, not as one patch. Third: make --raw the DEFAULT for the ranking column, or refuse to print 'real' for a webfrank-pinned function, because SuicideExplosion's headline 'real 0' is the rule's, not the compiler's.
